text: Ko wano no hawrirɗaa nii -an Nulaaɗo- immorde e yimɓe maaɗa ɓen e lorreede e sakkeede ka Laawol maaɗa, Men waɗirani kala Annabaajo immorde e Annabaaɓe ɓen ado maaɗa gaño immorde e bonɓe ɓen ka yimɓe makko, Joomi maaɗa yonii Fewnoowo mo no fewna faade e Goonga kan, O yonii e ɗum Ballo Mo no walle e dow gaño maaɗa on.
